name: Ryoujoku Koukan Nikki [Chikashitsu Hen] ~Sensei ni Tsurete Ikareta no wa, Furui Biru no Chikashitsu Deshita~
original_name: 陵辱交換日記[地下室編] 〜先生に連れて行かれたのは、古いビルの地下室でした〜
source:
A new teacher finds the diary of unforgivable teacher-student deeds. 
Ayase's humiliations continue with the insatiable Mr. Samejiro. 

In a secret basement, a gangbang unfolds with unknown men. 
"I will keep my promise... Please, everyone... do as you like... to me." 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE179738.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一名新教师发现了一本记录不可饶恕师生行为的日记。

绫濑在贪得无厌的鲨次郎老师手中继续遭受凌辱。

在秘密地下室里，一场陌生男人参与的轮奸正在展开。

“我会遵守约定……求求你们，大家……想怎么做都可以……对我做什么都行。”

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE179738.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
